description: This file defines the BestImagePlugin class, which implements logic to select the best recipe image based on various criteria, including parsing image URLs, metadata, and schema data. It includes methods for normalizing image entries, collecting candidates, scoring, and selecting the best image.

classes.name: BestImagePlugin
classes.description: A plugin class for selecting the best available recipe image based on various heuristics and metadata.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Decorator method that wraps a function to select the best image after execution.

methods.name: _collect_candidates
methods.description: Collects image candidates from primary data, schema, and OpenGraph metadata.

methods.name: _normalize_entries
methods.description: Normalizes different formats of image entries into a standard dictionary with url, width, and height.

methods.name: _collect_opengraph_candidates
methods.description: Extracts image candidates from OpenGraph meta tags in HTML soup.

methods.name: _merge_candidate
methods.description: Merges a candidate image into the candidates list, updating dimensions and sources.

methods.name: _max_dimension
methods.description: Returns the maximum of two dimension values.

methods.name: _parse_dimension
methods.description: Parses a dimension value from string, number, or dict.

methods.name: _select_best_candidate
methods.description: Selects the best candidate based on scoring criteria.

methods.name: _score_candidate
methods.description: Scores a candidate image based on size, security, and order.

methods.name: _ensure_dimensions
methods.description: Ensures candidate has width and height, extracting from URL if necessary.

methods.name: _extract_dimensions_from_url
methods.description: Extracts image dimensions from URL pattern or query parameters.

methods.name: _find_query_dimension
methods.description: Finds dimension value in URL query parameters.
